questions.text: मेहुल तथा बरखा की पुस्तकें दर्शा रही हैं कि 31 मार्च, 2025 को उनकी विनियोजित पूँजी ₹ 6,00,000 थी । यदि सामान्य लाभ ₹ 60,000 तथा अधिलाभ ₹ 20,000 हैं, तो प्रतिफल की सामान्य दर है :
questions.text_english: The books of Mehul and Barkha showed that their capital employed on 31st March, 2025 was ₹6,00,000. If the normal profits are ₹60,000 and super profits are ₹20,000, then the normal rate of return is:
questions.solution: Option D is correct because the normal rate of return is calculated by dividing the normal profits by the capital employed and multiplying by 100. Thus, (60,000 / 6,00,000) * 100 gives a normal rate of return of 10%.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है क्योंकि सामान्य प्रतिफल दर की गणना सामान्य लाभ को विनियोजित पूँजी से विभाजित कर 100 से गुणा करके की जाती है। इस प्रकार, (60,000 / 6,00,000) * 100 करने पर सामान्य प्रतिफल दर 10% प्राप्त होती है।

यहाँ दो कथन हैं, अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) :
अभिकथन (A): साझेदारी समझौता साझेदारों के बीच संबंधों का आधार बन जाता है।
कारण (R) : साझेदारी दो या दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के बीच व्यवसाय करने तथा इसके लाभ-हानि विभाजित करने के समझौते का परिणाम है।
निम्न में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
There are two statements Assertion (A) and Reason (R) :
Assertion (A): Partnership Agreement becomes the basis of relationship among the partners.
Reason (R) : Partnership is the result of an agreement between two or more persons to do business and share its profits and losses.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.

questions.solution: Option A is correct because both the assertion and reason statements accurately describe the nature of a partnership, and the definition provided in the reason logically explains why the agreement forms the foundation of their relationship.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प A सही है क्योंकि अभिकथन और कारण दोनों साझेदारी की प्रकृति का सटीक वर्णन करते हैं, और कारण में दी गई परिभाषा तार्किक रूप से बताती है कि समझौता उनके संबंधों का आधार क्यों बनता है।

sub_questions.text: तरुण तथा तेज एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे। 1 अप्रैल, 2024 को तेज ने फर्म को ₹ 50,000 का ऋण दिया। ऋण पर ब्याज लगाने से पूर्व फर्म का शुद्ध लाभ ₹ 3,75,000 था। फर्म अपनी पुस्तकें प्रतिवर्ष 31 मार्च को बन्द करती है। लाभ-हानि खाते से लाभ-हानि विनियोजन खाते में हस्तांतरित की गयी लाभ की राशि होगी :
sub_questions.text_english: Tarun and Tej were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. On 1st April 2024, Tej had given a loan of ₹50,000 to the firm. The net profit of the firm before charging interest on loan was ₹3,75,000. The firm closes its books on 31st March every year. The amount of profit transferred from Profit and Loss Account to Profit and Loss Appropriation Account will be :
sub_questions.solution: Option B is correct because interest on a partner's loan is a charge against profit. In the absence of an agreement, interest is calculated at 6% p.a., amounting to ₹3,000 for the full year on ₹50,000. Deducting this from ₹3,75,000 leaves ₹3,72,000 to be transferred to the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account.

sub_questions.text: अशोक तथा वासु एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4:3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2025 को उनकी पूँजी क्रमशः ₹ 3,00,000 तथा ₹ 3,75,000 थी। 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में वासु ने अपने व्यक्तिगत उपयोग के लिए ₹ 40,000 का आहरण किया तथा ₹ 1,50,000 की अतिरिक्त पूँजी व्यवसाय में लगाई। 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए फर्म का लाभ ₹ 1,40,000 था। वर्ष के आरम्भ में वासु की पूँजी थी :
sub_questions.text_english: Ashok and Vasu were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3. Their capitals on 31st March, 2025 were ₹3,00,000 and ₹3,75,000 respectively. During the year ended 31st March, 2025 Vasu withdrew ₹40,000 for his personal use and introduced ₹1,50,000 as additional capital in the business. Profit of the firm for the year ended 31st March, 2025 was ₹1,40,000. Vasu's capital in the beginning of the year was:
sub_questions.solution: Option C is correct because the opening capital is calculated by adjusting the closing capital. Taking Vasu's closing capital of ₹3,75,000, adding drawings of ₹40,000, and deducting additional capital of ₹1,50,000 and his share of profit (3/7 of ₹1,40,000 = ₹60,000), we get the opening capital of ₹2,05,000.

questions.text: सोनी तथा कुश एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4: 5 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । हितेश को फर्म के लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए एक नए साझेदार के रूप में फर्म में प्रवेश दिया गया । सामान्य संचय, ख्याति तथा परिसम्पत्तियों के पुनर्मूल्यांकन एवं देयताओं के पुनर्निर्धारण पर लाभ सम्बन्धी सभी समायोजनों को करने के पश्चात् सोनी तथा कुश के पूँजी खातों के शेष क्रमशः ₹ 7,00,000 तथा ₹ 13,00,000 थे । हितेश फर्म के लाभों में अपने 1/5 भाग के लिए आनुपातिक पूँजी लाया । हितेश द्वारा लाई गई आनुपातिक पूँजी की राशि थी :
questions.text_english: Soni and Kush were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:5. Hitesh was admitted as a new partner for 1/5th share in the profits of the firm. After all adjustments regarding general reserve, goodwill, and gain on revaluation of assets and reassessment of liabilities, the balances in capital accounts of Soni and Kush were ₹7,00,000 and ₹13,00,000 respectively. Hitesh brought in proportionate capital for his 1/5th share in the profits of the firm. The amount of proportionate capital brought in by Hitesh was:
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the combined adjusted capital of Soni and Kush is ₹20,00,000 (7,00,000 + 13,00,000). Since Hitesh's share is 1/5, the remaining 4/5 share corresponds to ₹20,00,000. Total capital of the firm is thus ₹25,00,000, meaning Hitesh's proportionate capital contribution is 1/5 of ₹25,00,000, which equals ₹5,00,000.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि सोनी और कुश की समायोजित संयुक्त पूँजी ₹20,00,000 है। हितेश का हिस्सा 1/5 होने के कारण, शेष 4/5 हिस्सा ₹20,00,000 के बराबर है। अतः फर्म की कुल पूँजी ₹25,00,000 होगी, और हितेश की 1/5 आनुपातिक पूँजी ₹5,00,000 होगी।

sub_questions.text_english: Chandan, Ravi and Mahesh were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:4:1. From 1st April, 2025 they decided to share the future profits in the ratio of 3:2:1. On that date there existed a general reserve of ₹7,00,000 in the books of the firm which they decided to distribute among themselves. In which ratio will the general reserve be distributed among the partners?
sub_questions.solution: Option B is correct because any accumulated profits or general reserves existing at the time of a change in profit-sharing ratio are always distributed among the partners in their old profit-sharing ratio unless agreed otherwise.

sub_questions.text: सुमन तथा तान्या एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2025 से उन्होंने लाभों को बराबर-बराबर बाँटने का निर्णय लिया। उस तिथि को फर्म की पुस्तकों में फर्नीचर ₹ 4,50,000 पर दिखाया गया था। लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात में परिवर्तन के समय इसका मूल्य 10% कम पाया गया। नए स्थिति विवरण में फर्नीचर को दिखाया जाएगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Suman and Tanya were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2:1. With effect from 1st April, 2025, they decided to share the profits equally. On that date furniture was appearing in the books of the firm at ₹4,50,000. At the time of change in the profit sharing ratio, it was found to be undervalued by 10%. In the new balance sheet, furniture will be shown at:
sub_questions.solution: Option D is correct because the book value of ₹4,50,000 represents 90% of the actual value due to 10% undervaluation. The actual value is calculated as (4,50,000 / 90) * 100, which equals ₹5,00,000, and this revised value is shown in the new balance sheet.

questions.text: तुला, राम तथा माधवी एक फर्म के साझेदार थे। साझेदारी संलेख में साझेदारों के आहरण पर 12% प्रतिवर्ष ब्याज का प्रावधान था। फर्म प्रतिवर्ष अपने खाते 31 मार्च को बन्द करती है। 31 दिसम्बर, 2025 से शुरू करके माधवी ने प्रत्येक माह के अन्त में ₹ 40,000 का आहरण अपने व्यक्तिगत उपयोग के लिए किया । माधवी के आहरण पर ब्याज होगा :
questions.text_english: Tula, Ram and Madhvi were partners in a firm. The partnership deed provided for interest on partners drawings @ 12% p.a. The firm closes its books on 31st March every year. Starting from 31st December, 2025 Madhvi withdrew ₹40,000 at the end of every month for her personal use. Interest on Madhvi's drawings will be :
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the drawings are made at the end of the month from December to March, meaning there are 4 withdrawals totaling ₹1,60,000. The average period is (3 months + 0 months)/2 = 1.5 months. The interest is calculated as 1,60,000 * 12/100 * 1.5/12, which equals ₹2,400.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि आहरण दिसंबर से मार्च के अंत में किए गए हैं, जिसका अर्थ है 4 बार कुल ₹1,60,000 का आहरण। औसत अवधि (3 + 0)/2 = 1.5 माह होगी। ब्याज की गणना 1,60,000 * 12/100 * 1.5/12 करने पर ₹2,400 प्राप्त होती है।

sub_questions.text_english: Dharam, Karam and Raman were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 7:8:5. On 31st March, 2025, Raman retired from the firm. Dharam and Karam decided to share profits in future in the ratio of 11:9. Their gaining ratio will be :
sub_questions.solution: Option C is correct because the gaining ratio is calculated as New Share minus Old Share. Dharam's gain is 11/20 - 7/20 = 4/20. Karam's gain is 9/20 - 8/20 = 1/20. Therefore, the gaining ratio between Dharam and Karam is 4:1.

sub_questions.text: दीन, राजू तथा हरि एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 7: 6:7 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । 31 मार्च, 2025 को राजू का देहान्त हो गया। दीन तथा हरि ने राजू के भाग को बराबर-बराबर लेने का निर्णय लिया। दीन तथा हरि के बीच नया लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Deen, Raju and Hari were partners in a firm sharing profit and losses in the ratio of 7:6:7. On 31st March, 2025 Raju died. Deen and Hari decided to take over Raju's share equally. The new profit sharing ratio between Deen and Hari will be :
sub_questions.solution: Option A is correct because Raju's share is 6/20, which is taken equally by Deen and Hari (3/20 each). Deen's new share becomes 7/20 + 3/20 = 10/20. Hari's new share becomes 7/20 + 3/20 = 10/20. Thus, their new ratio simplifies to 1:1.

questions.text: निधि एवं कुनाल एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । उनकी पूँजी क्रमशः ₹ 3,00,000 तथा ₹ 2,00,000 थी। वे 6% वार्षिक दर से पूँजी पर ब्याज के अधिकारी थे। वर्ष के दौरान फर्म ने ₹ 15,000 का लाभ अर्जित किया । साझेदारों की पूँजी पर ब्याज होगा :
questions.text_english: Nidhi and Kunal were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:1. Their capitals were ₹3,00,000 and ₹2,00,000 respectively. They were entitled to interest on capital @ 6% p.a. The firm earned a profit of ₹15,000 during the year. Interest on partners' capitals will be :
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the required interest on capital (Nidhi: ₹18,000, Kunal: ₹12,000) totals ₹30,000, which exceeds the available profit of ₹15,000. In such cases of insufficient profit, the available profit is distributed in the ratio of their interest claims (18,000 : 12,000 or 3:2), resulting in ₹9,000 for Nidhi and ₹6,000 for Kunal.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि पूँजी पर आवश्यक कुल ब्याज ₹30,000 (निधि ₹18,000, कुनाल ₹12,000) है, जो ₹15,000 के उपलब्ध लाभ से अधिक है। अपर्याप्त लाभ की स्थिति में, उपलब्ध लाभ को उनके ब्याज के दावों के अनुपात (18:12 अर्थात 3:2) में वितरित किया जाता है, जिससे निधि को ₹9,000 और कुनाल को ₹6,000 प्राप्त होंगे।

questions.text: 1 अप्रैल, 2024 को दीना लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 8,000, 9% ऋणपत्रों का 6% बट्टे पर निर्गमन किया। 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त वर्ष के लिए ऋणपत्रों पर देय ब्याज की कुल राशि होगी :
questions.text_english: On 1st April, 2024, Dina Ltd. issued 8,000, 9% debentures of ₹100 each at a discount of 6%. The total amount of interest due on debentures for the year ended 31st March, 2025 will be:
questions.solution: Option B is correct because the interest on debentures is always calculated on the nominal (face) value, irrespective of whether they are issued at a discount or premium. The nominal value is ₹8,00,000 (8,000 × ₹100), and 9% of this amount results in an interest of ₹72,000.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है क्योंकि ऋणपत्रों पर ब्याज की गणना हमेशा उनके अंकित (सम) मूल्य पर की जाती है, चाहे वे बट्टे या प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित हुए हों। अंकित मूल्य ₹8,00,000 (8,000 × ₹100) है, जिस पर 9% की दर से ₹72,000 का ब्याज देय होगा।

questions.text: साक्षी लिमिटेड ने ₹ 10 प्रत्येक के 500 समता अंशों का, जिन्हें ₹ 2 प्रति अंश के प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित किया गया था, ₹ 4 प्रति अंश (प्रीमियम सहित) की दूसरी एवं अंतिम याचना का भुगतान न करने पर, हरण कर लिया। इन अंशों को अधिकतम कितनी छूट राशि पर पुनः निर्गमित किया जा सकता है ?
questions.text_english: Sakshi Ltd. forfeited 500 equity shares of ₹10 each, issued at a premium of ₹2 per share for non-payment of second and final call of ₹4 per share (including premium). The maximum amount of discount at which these shares can be reissued is:
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the maximum permissible discount on reissue of forfeited shares is strictly equal to the amount already received on those shares towards capital. Out of the ₹10 face value, the final call of ₹2 towards capital was unpaid (since ₹4 includes ₹2 premium), meaning ₹8 was paid up per share towards share capital. Thus, the maximum discount is ₹8 per share.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि हरण किए गए अंशों के पुनः निर्गमन पर दी जाने वाली अधिकतम छूट उन अंशों पर पहले ही प्राप्त पूँजीगत राशि के बराबर होती है। ₹10 के अंकित मूल्य में से ₹2 की अंतिम याचना का भुगतान नहीं किया गया था, अर्थात प्रति अंश ₹8 का भुगतान पूँजी के लिए प्राप्त हो चुका था, इसलिए अधिकतम छूट ₹8 प्रति अंश होगी।

questions.text:
सूर्या लिमिटेड ने ₹ 10 प्रत्येक के 50,000 समता अंशों का निर्गमन किया। राशि निम्न प्रकार से देय थी :
आवेदन पर ₹3 प्रति अंश
आबंटन पर ₹ 2 प्रति अंश
प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना पर - शेष
ऊषा ने, जिसे 700 अंश आबंटित किए गए थे, सम्पूर्ण अंश राशि का भुगतान आबंटन पर ही कर दिया । राज ने, जिसे 300 अंश आबंटित किए गए थे, प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना का भुगतान नहीं किया । प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना के लिए बैंक खाते में डेबिट की जाने वाली राशि उसके देय होने के बाद होगी :
questions.text_english:
Surya Ltd. issued 50,000 equity shares of ₹10 each. The amount was payable as follows:
on Application-₹3 per share
on Allotment-₹2 per share
on First and Final Call - the balance
Usha, to whom 700 shares were allotted, paid her entire share money on allotment. Raj, to whom 300 shares were allotted did not pay the first and final call. The amount to be debited to Bank Account for first and final call after it becomes due will be:
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the total amount due on the first and final call is ₹2,50,000 (50,000 shares * ₹5 balance). From this, we deduct the advance already received from Usha (700 shares * ₹5 = ₹3,500) and the arrears from Raj (300 shares * ₹5 = ₹1,500). The final amount received by the bank is ₹2,50,000 - ₹3,500 - ₹1,500 = ₹2,45,000.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि प्रथम एवं अंतिम याचना पर देय कुल राशि ₹2,50,000 (50,000 अंश * ₹5) है। इसमें से ऊषा से प्राप्त अग्रिम (₹3,500) और राज की बकाया राशि (₹1,500) घटाने पर बैंक खाते में डेबिट की जाने वाली राशि ₹2,45,000 प्राप्त होगी।

questions.text: सिद्धि, ज्ञान तथा गायत्री एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 3:2:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । 31 मार्च, 2025 को उनकी फर्म का विघटन हो गया। विघटन के समय ₹25,000 के एक देनदार ने, जिसका ऋण पूर्व में डूबत ऋण के रूप में अपलिखित कर दिया गया था, राशि के 40% का भुगतान कर दिया । उपरोक्त लेनदेन के लिए लेखांकन होगा :
questions.text_english: Sidhi, Gyan and Gayatri were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:2. On 31st March, 2025 their firm was dissolved. At the time of dissolution a debtor amounting to ₹25,000 whose debt had been previously written off as bad debt paid 40% of the amount. The accounting treatment for the above transaction will be :

options.A: ₹10,000 डूबत ऋण वसूली खाते में क्रेडिट किये जायेंगे ।
options.B: ₹10,000 देनदार के व्यक्तिगत खाते में क्रेडिट किये जायेंगे ।
options.D: ₹10,000 डूबत ऋण खाते में क्रेडिट किए जायेंगे ।

options_english.A: ₹10,000 will be credited to bad debts recovered account.
options_english.B: ₹10,000 will be credited to the debtor's personal account.
options_english.C: ₹10,000 will be credited to realisation account.
options_english.D: ₹10,000 will be credited to bad debts account.

questions.solution: Option C is correct because during the dissolution of a partnership firm, any unrecorded asset or previously written-off bad debt that is recovered is directly credited to the Realisation Account. Here, 40% of ₹25,000 is ₹10,000, which will be credited to the Realisation Account.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है क्योंकि फर्म के विघटन के समय पूर्व में अपलिखित किसी भी डूबत ऋण की वसूली होने पर उस राशि को सीधे वसूली खाते में क्रेडिट किया जाता है। यहाँ ₹25,000 का 40% अर्थात ₹10,000 वसूली खाते में क्रेडिट होगा।

questions.text: चमन तथा वाटिका एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4: 5 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे। उन्होंने फर्म के लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए मोहन को एक नये साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया। मोहन ने अपना भाग चमन तथा वाटिका से बराबर-बराबर अधिग्रहित किया। चमन, वाटिका तथा मोहन का नया लाभ विभाजन अनुपात होगा :
questions.text_english: Chaman and Vatika were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:5. They admitted Mohan as a new partner for 1/5th share in the profits of the firm. Mohan acquired his share equally from Chaman and Vatika. The new profit sharing ratio of Chaman, Vatika and Mohan will be :
questions.solution: Option B is correct because Mohan acquires his 1/5th share equally, which means he takes 1/10th from Chaman and 1/10th from Vatika. Chaman's new share is (4/9 - 1/10) = 31/90. Vatika's new share is (5/9 - 1/10) = 41/90. Mohan's share is 1/5, which is 18/90. Therefore, the new ratio is 31:41:18.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है क्योंकि मोहन 1/5 हिस्सा बराबर लेता है, अर्थात चमन और वाटिका प्रत्येक से 1/10। चमन का नया हिस्सा (4/9 - 1/10) = 31/90 और वाटिका का (5/9 - 1/10) = 41/90 होगा। मोहन का हिस्सा 1/5 या 18/90 है। अतः नया अनुपात 31:41:18 है।

questions.text: ललिता, शिवानी तथा माधुरी एक फर्म की साझेदार थी तथा 3:2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटती थी। 31 मार्च, 2025 को माधुरी फर्म से सेवानिवृत्त हो गयी। सेवानिवृत्ति की तिथि को उसके पूँजी खाते में ₹ 1,80,000 का शेष था। ललिता तथा शिवानी उसके दावे के पूर्ण निपटान में उसे ₹2,25,000 का भुगतान करने के लिए सहमत हो गईं। माधुरी की सेवानिवृत्ति पर फर्म की ख्याति थी :
questions.text_english: Lalita, Shivani and Madhuri were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:1. Madhuri retired from the firm on 31st March, 2025. The balance in her capital account on the date of her retirement was ₹1,80,000. Lalita and Shivani agreed to pay her ₹2,25,000 in full settlement of her claim. The goodwill of the firm on Madhuri's retirement was:
questions.solution: Option D is correct because the excess amount paid to the retiring partner over their adjusted capital balance represents their share of hidden goodwill. Madhuri's share of goodwill is ₹2,25,000 - ₹1,80,000 = ₹45,000. Since Madhuri's profit share was 1/6, the total goodwill of the firm is calculated as ₹45,000 * 6/1, which equals ₹2,70,000.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है क्योंकि सेवानिवृत्त साझेदार को उसकी समायोजित पूँजी से अधिक भुगतान की गई राशि गुप्त ख्याति में उसका हिस्सा दर्शाती है। माधुरी का ख्याति में हिस्सा ₹45,000 है। उसका लाभ अनुपात 1/6 था, इसलिए फर्म की कुल ख्याति ₹45,000 * 6 = ₹2,70,000 होगी।

questions.text:
पिछले कुछ वर्षों में एक फर्म के औसत लाभ ₹ 8,00,000 हैं। इसी प्रकार के व्यवसाय में विनियोजित पूँजी पर प्रतिफल की सामान्य दर 10% है। व्यवसाय की परिसम्पत्तियाँ ₹ 60,00,000 तथा बाह्य देयताएँ ₹ 20,00,000 थी ।
फर्म की ख्याति की गणना कीजिए :
(i) अधिलाभों के पूँजीकरण विधि द्वारा
(ii) अधिलाभ विधि द्वारा यदि ख्याति का मूल्यांकन अधिलाभों के चार वर्षों के क्रय के आधार पर किया जाए ।
questions.text_english:
Average profit of a firm during the last few years is ₹8,00,000. In similar business, the normal rate of return is 10% of the capital employed. Assets of the business were ₹60,00,000 and its external liabilities were ₹20,00,000.
Calculate the value of goodwill by:
(i) Capitalisation of super profits method
(ii) Super profit method if the goodwill is valued at four years' purchase of super profits.

key_points: Capital Employed = Total Assets - External Liabilities = ₹60,00,000 - ₹20,00,000 = ₹40,00,000.
Normal Profit = 10% of ₹40,00,000 = ₹4,00,000. Super Profit = Average Profit - Normal Profit = ₹8,00,000 - ₹4,00,000 = ₹4,00,000.
(i) Goodwill by Capitalisation of Super Profits = Super Profit × (100 / Normal Rate of Return) = ₹4,00,000 × (100 / 10) = ₹40,00,000.
(ii) Goodwill by Super Profit Method = Super Profit × Number of Years' Purchase = ₹4,00,000 × 4 = ₹16,00,000.

questions.solution: First, the capital employed is calculated by subtracting external liabilities of ₹20,00,000 from the total assets of ₹60,00,000, resulting in ₹40,00,000. The normal profit is 10% of this capital employed, which equals ₹4,00,000. Deducting the normal profit from the given average profit of ₹8,00,000 gives a super profit of ₹4,00,000. Under the capitalisation of super profits method, goodwill is ₹4,00,000 multiplied by 100/10, amounting to ₹40,00,000. Under the super profit method based on four years' purchase, goodwill is calculated as ₹4,00,000 multiplied by 4, yielding ₹16,00,000.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किसी एक विकल्प का उत्तर दें:
questions.text_english: Attempt any one of the following options:

sub_questions.text: सुल्तान, सिंह तथा तुलसी एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 9: 7:4 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । उनकी स्थायी पूँजी क्रमशः ₹ 6,00,000; ₹ 5,00,000 तथा ₹ 4,00,000 थी । साझेदारी संलेख में पूँजी पर 10% वार्षिक ब्याज देने का प्रावधान था। वर्ष के अंतिम खाते तैयार करने के पश्चात् यह पाया गया कि पूँजी पर 12% वार्षिक दर से ब्याज लगाया गया है। आवश्यक समायोजन रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टि कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Sultan, Singh and Tulsi were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 9:7:4. Their fixed capitals were ₹6,00,000, ₹5,00,000 and ₹4,00,000. The partnership deed provided that interest on partners capital accounts will be allowed at 10% per annum. After the final accounts for the year were prepared, it was found that interest on capital was allowed @ 12% per annum. Pass the necessary adjusting journal entry.

key_points: Calculate excess interest charged at 2% on fixed capitals: Sultan = ₹12,000, Singh = ₹10,000, Tulsi = ₹8,000. Total = ₹30,000.
Distribute this ₹30,000 firm gain among partners in 9:7:4 ratio: Sultan = ₹13,500, Singh = ₹10,500, Tulsi = ₹6,000.
Net effect: Sultan's Current A/c Dr by ₹1,500; Singh's Current A/c Dr by ₹500; To Tulsi's Current A/c ₹2,000.

sub_questions.solution: The partners were incorrectly credited with 12% interest instead of 10%, resulting in an excess credit of 2%. This excess amounts to ₹12,000 for Sultan, ₹10,000 for Singh, and ₹8,000 for Tulsi, totaling ₹30,000. Reversing this excess credit means taking it back and distributing it as profit in their profit-sharing ratio of 9:7:4, which credits Sultan with ₹13,500, Singh with ₹10,500, and Tulsi with ₹6,000. The net adjusting entry requires debiting Sultan's Current Account with ₹1,500 and Singh's Current Account with ₹500, while crediting Tulsi's Current Account with ₹2,000.

sub_questions.text: समीर तथा मनवीर एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 5:3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2024 को उन्होंने लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए संदीप को ₹80,000 की न्यूनतम गारंटी राशि के साथ एक नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया। समीर तथा मनवीर ने पहले की तरह ही लाभों को बाँटना जारी रखा परन्तु संदीप को दी गयी गारंटी के कारण हुई किसी भी कमी को 3:5 के अनुपात में वहन करने पर सहमति हुई। 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए फर्म का शुद्ध लाभ ₹ 3,20,000 था । 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष के लिए समीर, मनवीर तथा संदीप का लाभ-हानि विनियोजन खाता तैयार कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Sameer and Manveer were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3. On 1st April, 2024, they admitted Sandeep as a new partner for 1/5th share in the profits with a guaranteed minimum amount of ₹80,000. Sameer and Manveer continue to share profits as before but agreed to bear any deficiency on account of guarantee to Sandeep in the ratio of 3:5. The net profit of the firm for the year ended 31st March, 2025 was ₹3,20,000. Prepare Profit and Loss Appropriation Account of Sameer, Manveer and Sandeep for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

key_points: Sandeep's standard share = 1/5 of ₹3,20,000 = ₹64,000. Guaranteed minimum is ₹80,000. Deficiency is ₹16,000.
Deficiency borne by Sameer (3/8 of 16,000 = ₹6,000) and Manveer (5/8 of 16,000 = ₹10,000).

श्री तथा हरि एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 2: 3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे। उनकी स्थायी पूँजी क्रमशः ₹ 4,00,000 तथा ₹ 3,00,000 थी। साझेदारी संलेख में हरि को शुद्ध लाभ पर 5% कमीशन देने का प्रावधान था। 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त वर्ष का फर्म का शुद्ध लाभ ₹ 1,00,000 था।
फर्म की पुस्तकों में निम्नलिखित रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए :
(i) हरि के चालू खाते में हरि का कमीशन क्रेडिट करने के लिए।
(ii) कमीशन को लाभ-हानि विनियोजन खाते में हस्तांतरित करने के लिए ।
questions.text_english:
Shree and Hari were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2:3. Their fixed capitals were ₹4,00,000 and ₹3,00,000 respectively. The partnership deed provided that Hari is to be allowed a commission of 5% of net profit. The net profit of the firm for the year ended 31st March, 2025 was ₹1,00,000.
Pass the following journal entries in the books of the firm :
(i) For crediting Hari's commission to his current account.
(ii) For transferring the commission to Profit and Loss Appropriation Account.

key_points: Hari's commission is calculated as 5% of the net profit of ₹1,00,000, which equals ₹5,000.
(i) Commission A/c Dr. ₹5,000 To Hari's Current A/c ₹5,000 (Crediting commission).
(ii) Profit and Loss Appropriation A/c Dr. ₹5,000 To Commission A/c ₹5,000 (Transferring commission).

questions.solution: First, the commission amount is calculated by taking 5% of the net profit of ₹1,00,000, giving ₹5,000. Since capitals are fixed, this amount must route to the current account. For the first entry, debit Partner's Commission Account with ₹5,000 and credit Hari's Current Account with ₹5,000. For the second entry, debit the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account with ₹5,000 and credit the Partner's Commission Account with ₹5,000 to formally transfer the expense.

questions.text:
1 अप्रैल, 2024 को भूमिका लिमिटेड ने ₹ 500 प्रत्येक के 500, 9% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन 10% बट्टे पर किया, जिनका शोधन पाँच वर्ष पश्चात् 6% प्रीमियम पर करना था। 31 मार्च, 2025 को कम्पनी के प्रतिभूति प्रीमियम खाते में ₹ 30,000 का शेष था ।
9% ऋणपत्रों के निर्गमन तथा ऋणपत्र निर्गमन हानि को अपलिखित करने के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए । 'ऋणपत्र निर्गमन हानि-खाता' भी तैयार कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: On 1st April, 2024 Bhumika Ltd. issued 500, 9% debentures of ₹500 each at a discount of 10% redeemable at a premium of 6% after five years. On 31st March, 2025 the company had a balance of ₹30,000 in its Securities Premium Account. Pass necessary journal entries for issue of 9% Debentures and writing off Loss on issue of Debentures. Also prepare 'Loss on Issue of Debentures Account'.

key_points: Face Value = ₹2,50,000. Discount = ₹25,000. Premium on Redemption = ₹15,000. Total Loss = ₹40,000.
Entry 1: Bank A/c Dr. ₹2,25,000; To Debenture Application and Allotment A/c ₹2,25,000.
Entry 2: Deb App and Allot A/c Dr. ₹2,25,000; Loss on Issue of Debentures A/c Dr. ₹40,000; To 9% Debentures A/c ₹2,50,000; To Premium on Redemption of Debentures A/c ₹15,000.
Entry 3: Securities Premium A/c Dr. ₹30,000; Statement of Profit and Loss Dr. ₹10,000; To Loss on Issue of Debentures A/c ₹40,000.
Loss on Issue of Debentures Account should show balance brought in and matched against SPR and P&L.

questions.solution: The face value of the debentures is ₹2,50,000. A 10% discount means ₹25,000 is deducted upon issue, while a 6% redemption premium means ₹15,000 is payable later, creating a total 'Loss on Issue of Debentures' of ₹40,000. Record the receipt by debiting Bank A/c and crediting Debenture Application & Allotment A/c with ₹2,25,000. Next, debit Application & Allotment with ₹2,25,000 and Loss on Issue with ₹40,000, crediting 9% Debentures with ₹2,50,000 and Premium on Redemption with ₹15,000. To write off the loss, utilize the full ₹30,000 balance from the Securities Premium Account and take the remaining ₹10,000 from the Statement of Profit and Loss. The ledger account will reflect the debited ₹40,000 matched by credits to SPR and P&L.

questions.text:
किरन, रवीना तथा हिना एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 5:3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । फर्म प्रतिवर्ष अपनी पुस्तकें 31 मार्च को बन्द करती है। साझेदारी संलेख की शर्तों के अनुसार, किसी भी साझेदार की मृत्यु पर फर्म की ख्याति की गणना पिछले तीन वर्षों के औसत लाभ के चार गुना के आधार पर की जाएगी। 1 जुलाई, 2025 को हिना की मृत्यु हो गयी। पिछले तीन वर्षों के लाभ थे :
2022-23 ₹4,75,000
2023-24 ₹4,05,000
2024-25 ₹3,20,000
मृत्यु की तिथि तक लाभ में हिना के भाग की गणना पिछले वर्ष के लाभ के आधार पर की जाएगी।
(i) फर्म की ख्याति की तथा ख्याति में हिना के भाग की गणना कीजिए ।
(ii) मृत्यु की तिथि तक फर्म के लाभों में हिना के भाग की गणना कीजिए ।
(iii) ख्याति खाता खोले बिना ख्याति के लेखांकन तथा हिना की मृत्यु के समय लाभ में उसके भाग के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Kiran, Raveena and Hina were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3:2. The firm closes its books on 31st March every year. As per the terms of the partnership deed, on the death of any partner, the goodwill of the firm will be calculated on the basis of four times the average profits of the last three years. Hina died on 1st July 2025. The Profits for the last three years were :
2022-23 ₹4,75,000
2023-24 ₹4,05,000
2024-25 ₹3,20,000
Hina's share of profit upto the date of death was to be calculated on the basis of previous year's profit.
(i) Calculate goodwill of the firm and Hina's share of goodwill.
(ii) Calculate Hina's share in the profits of the firm till the date of her death.
(iii) Pass necessary journal entries for the treatment of goodwill without opening goodwill account and for Hina's share of profit at the time of her death.

key_points: (ii) Profit share calculation: Time elapsed = 3 months (April to June). Base profit = ₹3,20,000. Hina's share of profit = ₹3,20,000 × (3/12) × (2/10) = ₹16,000.
(iii) Entry for Goodwill: Kiran's Capital A/c Dr. ₹2,00,000; Raveena's Capital A/c Dr. ₹1,20,000; To Hina's Capital A/c ₹3,20,000 (Gaining ratio 5:3).
Entry for Profit: Profit and Loss Suspense A/c Dr. ₹16,000; To Hina's Capital A/c ₹16,000.

questions.solution: First, calculate the average profit over the three years, which gives ₹4,00,000. Multiplying this by four years' purchase yields a total firm goodwill of ₹16,00,000, making Hina's 2/10 share worth ₹3,20,000. Next, calculate Hina's profit share for the 3 months she survived in the current year using the previous year's profit of ₹3,20,000; this is computed as ₹3,20,000 × 3/12 × 2/10, yielding ₹16,000. Finally, record the journal entries. For goodwill, debit Kiran's and Raveena's Capital Accounts in their gaining ratio of 5:3 (₹2,00,000 and ₹1,20,000 respectively) and credit Hina's Capital Account with ₹3,20,000. For her profit share, debit Profit and Loss Suspense Account and credit Hina's Capital Account with ₹16,000.

रवनीत तथा मनमीत एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 7:3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे। 31 मार्च, 2025 को उनका स्थिति विवरण निम्न प्रकार से था :
[Table showing liabilities: Creditors 4,50,000; Capitals Ravneet 5,00,000, Manmeet 3,00,000. Assets: Cash at Bank 2,50,000, Stock 2,50,000, Debtors 2,00,000, Plant & Machinery 5,50,000]
उपरोक्त तिथि पर फर्म का विघटन हो गया। संयन्त्र तथा मशीनरी को ₹ 4,87,000 पर तथा स्टॉक को पुस्तकीय मूल्य से 20% कम पर बेचा गया। देनदारों से ₹ 1,40,000 वसूल हुए । रवनीत सभी वसूली व्ययों को वहन करने पर सहमत हो गया जिसके लिए उसे ₹9,000 का कमीशन दिया गया । वास्तविक वसूली व्यय ₹ 7,500 थे । वसूली खाता तथा साझेदारों के पूँजी खाते तैयार कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Ravneet and Manmeet were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 7:3. On 31st March, 2025, their Balance Sheet was as follows:
On the above date, the firm was dissolved. The plant and machinery was sold at ₹4,87,000 and stock at 20% less than the book value. Debtors realised ₹1,40,000. Ravneet agreed to bear all realisation expenses for which he was allowed a commission of ₹9,000. Actual realisation expenses amounted to ₹7,500. Prepare Realisation Account and Partners' Capital Accounts.

key_points: Transfer assets to Realisation A/c debit side (excluding bank): Stock 2.5L, Debtors 2L, Plant 5.5L = 10L.
Transfer Creditors 4.5L to Realisation A/c credit side.
Realisation of assets: Plant 4,87,000 + Stock 2,00,000 (2.5L less 20%) + Debtors 1,40,000 = Total ₹8,27,000 to Bank A/c credit side.
Payment of liabilities: Creditors paid ₹4,50,000.
Ravneet's commission ₹9,000 debited to Realisation A/c and credited to Ravneet's Capital A/c. Actual expenses of ₹7,500 borne by Ravneet do not affect Realisation A/c.
Calculate Loss on Realisation: Dr total 10L + 4.5L + 0.09L = 14.59L. Cr total 4.5L + 8.27L = 12.77L. Loss = ₹1,82,000. Distribute in 7:3 (Ravneet ₹1,27,400, Manmeet ₹54,600).
Capital Accounts: Ravneet's closing balance = 5L + 9k - 1,27,400 = ₹3,81,600 to be paid. Manmeet's closing balance = 3L - 54,600 = ₹2,45,400 to be paid.

questions.solution: In the Realisation Account, record the transfer of Sundry Assets (Stock, Debtors, Plant & Machinery) at their book value totaling ₹10,00,000 on the debit side, and Sundry Creditors at ₹4,50,000 on the credit side. Record the cash realised from assets as a credit of ₹8,27,000. The payment of creditors must be recorded as a debit of ₹4,50,000. The ₹9,000 commission to Ravneet is debited to the Realisation Account, but his actual expenses of ₹7,500 are ignored as they are his personal liability. The resulting loss of ₹1,82,000 is distributed to Ravneet (₹1,27,400) and Manmeet (₹54,600) in their 7:3 ratio. Finally, the Partners' Capital Accounts are balanced after posting opening balances, the realisation loss, and Ravneet's commission, resulting in final cash payments of ₹3,81,600 to Ravneet and ₹2,45,400 to Manmeet.

questions.text_english: Attempt any one of the following options:

sub_questions.text: जैनरिक फार्मा लिमिटेड ने ₹ 10 प्रत्येक के 3,00,000 समता अंशों को ₹6 प्रति अंश प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित करने के लिए आवेदन आमन्त्रित किये। राशि का भुगतान निम्न प्रकार से देय था : आवेदन तथा आबंटन पर ₹4 प्रति अंश (₹ 2 प्रति अंश प्रीमियम सहित), प्रथम एवं अन्तिम याचना पर - शेष। 4,00,000 अंशों के लिए आवेदन प्राप्त हुए। 40,000 अंशों के लिए आवेदनों को रद्द कर दिया गया तथा आवेदन राशि लौटा दी गयी। शेष आवेदकों को आनुपातिक आधार पर अंशों का आबंटन किया गया। आवेदन पर प्राप्त अतिरिक्त राशि का समायोजन प्रथम एवं अन्तिम याचना पर देय राशि में कर लिया गया। 3,600 अंशों के एक आवेदक, जैन ने प्रथम एवं अन्तिम याचना का भुगतान नहीं किया। उसके अंशों का हरण कर लिया गया। उपरोक्त लेनदेनों के लिए जैनरिक फार्मा लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Generic Pharma Ltd. invited applications for using 3,00,000 equity shares of ₹10 each at a premium of ₹6 per share. The amount was payable as follows: on Application and Allotment - ₹4 per share (including premium of ₹2 per share), on First and Final Call - Balance. Applications for 4,00,000 shares were received. Applications for 40,000 shares were rejected and the application money was refunded. Shares were allotted on pro-rata basis to the remaining applicants. Excess money received on applications was adjusted towards sums due on first and final call. Jain, an applicant for 3,600 shares failed to pay the first and final call. His shares were forfeited. Pass necessary journal entries in the books of Generic Pharma Ltd. for the above transactions.

key_points: Total application money received = 4,00,000 × ₹4 = ₹16,00,000.

Money refunded for 40,000 shares = ₹1,60,000. Capital transferred = 3,00,000 × ₹2 = ₹6,00,000. Premium = 3,00,000 × ₹2 = ₹6,00,000. Excess shifted to Calls in Advance = 60,000 shares × ₹4 = ₹2,40,000.
Bank receipt on call = ₹36,00,000 - ₹2,40,000 (advance) - ₹33,600 (arrears) = ₹33,26,400.
Forfeiture entry: Debit Share Capital ₹30,000, Debit SPR ₹12,000 (for unpaid premium on call), Credit Calls in Arrears ₹33,600, Credit Share Forfeiture ₹8,400.

sub_questions.solution: First, record the receipt of application money for 4,00,000 shares at ₹4, totaling ₹16,00,000. When allotting shares, transfer ₹6,00,000 to Share Capital and ₹6,00,000 to Securities Premium for the 3,00,000 accepted shares. Refund ₹1,60,000 for the 40,000 rejected shares and transfer the remaining ₹2,40,000 to Calls in Advance. Make the first and final call due for ₹36,00,000. sub_questions.text: संजय तथा विजय एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4 : 3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2025 को उन्होंने फर्म के लाभों में 2/5 भाग के लिए बाबुल को एक नए साझेदार के रूप में फर्म में प्रवेश दिया। बाबुल के प्रवेश पर निम्नलिखित पर सहमति हुई : (i) संजय, विजय तथा बाबुल का नया लाभ विभाजन अनुपात 3:3:4 होगा। (ii) फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन पिछले तीन वर्षों के औसत लाभ के चार वर्षों के क्रय के आधार पर किया जायेगा । पिछले तीन वर्षों के लाभ थे : 2022-23 ₹16,500; 2023-24 ₹17,500; 2024-25 ₹18,500। (iii) बाबुल ख्याति प्रीमियम का अपना भाग नगद लायेगा जिसके आधे का संजय तथा विजय द्वारा आहरण किया जायेगा । (iv) बाबुल के प्रवेश पर परिसम्पत्तियों के पुनर्मूल्यांकन तथा देयताओं के पुनर्निर्धारण के परिणामस्वरूप ₹ 70,000 की हानि हुई । (v) बाबुल के प्रवेश पर फर्म में ₹ 28,000 का सामान्य संचय था । (vi) ख्याति, पुनर्मूल्यांकन पर हुई हानि तथा सामान्य संचय से सम्बन्धित सभी आवश्यक समायोजनों के पश्चात् संजय तथा विजय के पूँजी खाते क्रमशः ₹ 3,50,000 तथा ₹ 2,50,000 का शेष दर्शा रहे थे। बाबुल फर्म के लाभों में अपने 2/5 भाग के लिए आनुपातिक पूँजी लाया । अपने कार्य (गणनाओं) को स्पष्ट रूप से दर्शाते हुए बाबुल के प्रवेश पर उपरोक्त लेनदेनों के लिए फर्म की पुस्तकों में आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Sanjay and Vijay were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3. On 1st April, 2025 they admitted Babul as a new partner for 2/5th share in the profits of the firm. On Babul's admission, the following was agreed upon: (i) The new profit sharing ratio of Sanjay, Vijay and Babul will be 3:3:4. (ii) The goodwill of the firm will be valued at four years purchase of the average profits of the last three years. The profits of the previous three years were: 16,500, 17,500, 18,500. (iii) Babul will bring his share of goodwill premium in cash, half of which will be withdrawn by Sanjay and Vijay. (iv) Revaluation loss was ₹70,000. (v) General Reserve was ₹28,000. (vi) Adjusted capitals were ₹3,50,000 and ₹2,50,000. Babul brought proportionate capital. Pass necessary journal entries.

key_points: Sacrificing ratio: Sanjay = 4/7 - 3/10 = 19/70. Vijay = 3/7 - 3/10 = 9/70. Ratio is 19:9.
Goodwill calculation: Avg profit = ₹17,500. Firm GW = 17,500 × 4 = ₹70,000. Babul's share = ₹28,000.
Entries for Goodwill: Premium for GW Dr ₹28,000 To Sanjay (19k) To Vijay (9k). Withdrawal entry for half the amount.
Revaluation loss of ₹70,000 and General Reserve of ₹28,000 entries distributed in 4:3 ratio.
Calculate Babul's capital: Combined adjusted capital = 3,50,000 + 2,50,000 = ₹6,00,000. This represents 3/5th share. Total capital = ₹10,00,000. Babul's capital = ₹4,00,000.
Bank receipt entry for Babul's Capital and Goodwill.

sub_questions.solution: First, calculate the firm's goodwill based on average profits (₹17,500), which equals ₹70,000. Babul's 2/5th share is ₹28,000. Record the distribution of the General Reserve (₹28,000) and the Revaluation Loss (₹70,000) between Sanjay and Vijay in their old ratio of 4:3. Debit the new partner's cash inflow for premium and distribute it in the sacrificing ratio of 19:9, crediting Sanjay with ₹19,000 and Vijay with ₹9,000. Debit their capital accounts to record the 50% withdrawal of this premium in cash. To find Babul's capital, take the combined adjusted capital of Sanjay and Vijay (₹6,00,000), which represents a 3/5th share of the firm. The total capital is ₹10,00,000, making Babul's proportionate contribution ₹4,00,000. Finally, record the receipt of ₹4,00,000 towards capital along with his premium contribution in the Bank Account.

sub_questions.text: अनुज, दिविज़ तथा शिल्पा एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 2: 1: 2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2023 को उनका स्थिति विवरण निम्न प्रकार था : [Table: Capitals Anuj 3L, Divij 4L, Shilpa 5L. BP 60k, Creditors 1.2L. Assets: Land 8L, Furniture 2.4L, Stock 1.2L, Debtors 1.7L, Cash 50k]. उपरोक्त तिथि को निम्नलिखित शर्तों पर अनुज फर्म से सेवानिवृत्त हो गया : (i) ख्याति में अनुज के भाग का मूल्य ₹ 90,000 था और इसका लेखांकन ख्याति खाता खोले बिना किया जाना था। (ii) परिसम्पत्तियों के पुनर्मूल्यांकन तथा देयताओं के पुनर्निर्धारण के परिणामस्वरूप ₹25,000 का लाभ हुआ । (iii) अनुज़ को देय राशि उसके ऋण खाते में स्थानान्तरित की जानी थी जिसका भुगतान 31 मार्च, 2024 से प्रारम्भ करके दो बराबर वार्षिक किस्तों में 12% वार्षिक ब्याज दर सहित किया जाएगा। साझेदारों के पूँजी खाते तथा अनुज का ऋण खाता तैयार कीजिए जब तक उसका पूर्णरूप से भुगतान न कर दिया जाए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Anuj, Divij and Shilpa were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2:1:2. Their Balance Sheet as at 31st March, 2023 was as follows: Anuj retired on the above date on the following terms: (i) Anuj's share of goodwill was valued at ₹90,000 and the same was to be treated without opening goodwill account. (ii) Revaluation of assets and reassessment of liabilities resulted in a gain of ₹25,000. (iii) Amount due to Anuj was transferred to his loan account, to be paid in two equal yearly instalments plus interest @ 12% p.a. on the unpaid balance starting from 31st March, 2024. Prepare Partners' Capital Accounts and Anuj's Loan Account till it is fully discharged.

key_points: Capital A/c updates: Opening balances (3L, 4L, 5L). Add revaluation gain in 2:1:2 (Anuj 10k, Divij 5k, Shilpa 10k).
Goodwill adjustment: Anuj gets 90k, borne by Divij and Shilpa in 1:2 gaining ratio. Divij debited 30k, Shilpa debited 60k.
Anuj's final balance transferred to Loan A/c: 3,00,000 + 10,000 + 90,000 = ₹4,00,000.
Anuj's Loan Account: Principal ₹4,00,000. Two instalments of ₹2,00,000 each plus interest.
Year 2 Interest: 12% on 2,00,000 = 24,000. Payment 2 = 2,24,000. Account closed.

sub_questions.solution: In the Capital Accounts, start with the opening balances and credit each partner with their share of the ₹25,000 revaluation gain in the 2:1:2 ratio. For goodwill, credit Anuj with his ₹90,000 share and debit Divij and Shilpa in their gaining ratio of 1:2. Anuj's total adjusted capital balance becomes ₹4,00,000, which is transferred to his Loan Account. In Anuj's Loan Account, record the opening balance of ₹4,00,000. At the end of the first year, charge 12% interest (₹48,000) and record the first installment payment of ₹2,48,000 (₹2,00,000 principal + interest), leaving a balance of ₹2,00,000. At the end of the second year, charge 12% interest on the remaining balance (₹24,000) and record the final payment of ₹2,24,000 to fully discharge the loan.

key_points: Current Assets = Total Assets - Non-Current Assets = ₹6,00,000 - ₹5,20,000 = ₹80,000.
Total Liabilities = Shareholders' Funds + Non-Current Liab + Current Liab. 6,00,000 = 4,20,000 + 1,40,000 + Current Liabilities. Thus, CL = ₹40,000.
(i) Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities = ₹80,000 / ₹40,000 = 2:1.

sub_questions.solution: First, find Current Assets by subtracting Non-Current Assets from Total Assets (₹6,00,000 - ₹5,20,000 = ₹80,000). Next, determine Capital Employed as the sum of Shareholders' Funds and Non-Current Liabilities (₹5,60,000). The Debt to Capital Employed Ratio uses Non-Current Liabilities (Debt) over Capital Employed, which is 1,40,000/5,60,000, yielding a ratio of 0.25:1.

To find Total Assets, add Non-current Assets and Current Assets (₹36,00,000 + ₹14,00,000), giving ₹50,00,000. Finally, Indent controls add a specific margin space from the cell's edge, helping to create a visual data hierarchy.
